[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1760. She is the daughter of [[Glasco-146|Phillip Glasco]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasco-147]] is assessed at 34% (possible). Margaret’s c 1760 birth could fit Philip-147 born about 1740, but the captured account instead points to the elder Philip-146. Both generations of Dublin watchmakers are plausible in age, with the elder around forty-five and the younger around twenty.

Possible placement with a genuine competing father generation; the held marriage and will extracts do not name Margaret’s father.

Next useful test: Read Margaret’s marriage licence or will in full to distinguish the two Philips.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasco-149 WikiTree profile export for Glasco-149]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
